newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish December T-bill auction draws lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish December T-bill auction draws lower rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Friday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.54 percent for the three-month, 3.55 percent for the six-month series and 3.62 percent for the new nine-month series.
One month ago the three-month series, then with a maturity of four months, yielded 3.58 percent, with the six-month series, at that time with seven-month maturity, yielding 3.62 percent.

The central bank said it sold 4.3 billion crowns worth of the three-month series, 3.4 billion crowns of the six-month and 6.0 billion crowns worth of the nine-month series, giving a total of 13.7 billion crowns.--Copenhagen newsroom +45-33-969652
